name: Book an appointment
description: Collect service, date and time, confirm, then book.

slots.name: service
slots.prompt: What type of appointment do you need: repair, consultation, installation or demo?
slots.retry_prompt: Please choose one of: repair, consultation, installation or demo.

slots.name: date
slots.prompt: What date works for you? You can say something like next Tuesday or 2026-11-10.
slots.retry_prompt: I could not read that date. Try a date such as next Tuesday or 2026-11-10.

slots.name: time
slots.retry_prompt: What time works, for example 3pm or 15:30?

nodes.prompt: I will book a ${slots.service} on ${slots.date} at ${slots.time}. Shall I proceed?
nodes.message: No problem, let's pick a different time.
Booked. Your reference is ${result.appointment_id} for a ${result.service} on ${result.date} at ${result.time}.
You will receive a confirmation shortly. Is there anything else I can help with?
I could not complete the booking: ${last_error}.
Let me connect you with the scheduling team.
